title: Lava Armour
description: This project adds lava armour set and lava sword.
body:
# Lava Armour

> Harness the power of lava. Forge armor from the earth's fury.

Craft **Lava Shards** from lava buckets and use them to create fire-resistant armor and a blazing sword that sets your enemies ablaze.

---

## What This Mod Adds

###  Lava Shard
A crafting material extracted from lava buckets. When crafted, the empty bucket is returned to your inventory — just like making a cake with milk!

```
[Lava Bucket]
     ↓ craft
Lava Shard × 9  +  Empty Bucket × 1
```

---

### Lava Sword
- Attack power and durability on par with Diamond.
- Sets enemies **on fire for 5 seconds** on hit.
- Even one-shot kills will yield **cooked drops** (e.g. Steak, Cooked Chicken), because ignition is applied before death is calculated.

**Crafting Recipe:**
```
[ Shard ]
[ Shard ]
[  Stick ]
```

---

### Lava Armour Set
Four-piece armor that grants fire damage reduction, scaling with how many pieces you wear.

| Piece | Materials |
|---|---|
| Helmet | Shard × 5 |
| Chestplate | Shard × 8 |
| Leggings | Shard × 7 |
| Boots | Shard × 4 |

**Fire Damage Reduction (scales with pieces worn):**

| Pieces Worn | Reduction |
|---|---|
| 1 piece | 25% |
| 2 pieces | 50% |
| 3 pieces | 75% |
| **Full set (4 pieces)** | **Complete immunity (100%)** |

> Wearing the full set makes you completely immune to fire and lava damage!

---

## Requirements

- **Minecraft**: 1.21
- **Mod Loader**: Fabric
- **Required Dependency**: [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
